boundary_conditions.outlet: do-nothing natural traction nu*grad(u)n-p*n=0; no pressure point pin

arms.model: fixed Gaussian RBF edge network [2,16,16,3], 11 bases; outputs physical (u,v,p)
arms.implementation: run_campaign.py; geometry, loss and QoI formulas adapted from src/research_pipeline/sciml/dfg.py

arms.role: strong same-contract architecture comparator; not a claimed DFG SOTA reproduction
arms.model: five hidden tanh layers of width 64, output (u,v,p), same input/output scaling as RBF
arms.literature_status: No directly matching published PINN score for stationary DFG 2D-1 Re=20 was identified in literature-ac-dfg.md.

training.hardware: Kaggle GPU T4x2; one isolated process per T4, paired arms run concurrently
training.interior_pool: 16384 scrambled Sobol candidates with rejection inside the cylinder; same archived pool generator and seed streams for both arms
training.boundary_pools: 512 scrambled Sobol points per inlet, lower wall, upper wall, cylinder and outlet
training.common_loss: sum of normalized strong-form momentum-x, momentum-y, continuity, inlet velocity, three no-slip components, and outlet normal traction losses
training.parallel_schedule: for each seed, run RBF and MLP simultaneously on separate T4s; process seed pairs sequentially
training.checkpoint_selection: final state at cap; never select using FEATFLOW QoIs

primary_metrics: absolute error in Cl (small cancellation-sensitive reference)
evaluation.qoi_definition: FEATFLOW sigma=nu*grad(u)-pI; circular stress integral at 512 equiangular points; exact p(0.15,0.2)-p(0.25,0.2); 1024-point integral as quadrature-sensitivity diagnostic
secondary: change in QoIs from 512 to 1024 surface points
evaluation.field_score_behavior: field_relative_l2 is always null until an independently reviewed, converged FEM field exists

stop_rule.stop_each_run: first of 1200 synchronized GPU-seconds, non-finite loss/gradient, or fatal runtime failure
stop_rule.stop_campaign: hard script wall deadline; scoring allowance 600s; stop before a new seed pair if its run cap cannot fit
stop_rule.t4x2_quota_accounting: one hour of T4x2 Kaggle session runtime charges one quota hour; active device allocation is separately reported
stop_rule.optional_smoke: 120 seconds per arm; consume from the safety reserve, never add beyond the 2-hour session cap

provenance.execution_status: not run; no Kaggle upload, preflight, validation, training, or solver run performed
